notes: The program page gives no pay, residency rule or dates. Ask the Hyde Square Task Force before you apply.
name: Jovenes en Accion (Youth in Action)
what_you_do: Year-round program for grades 8 to 12. Join a dance, music or theatre team rooted in Afro-Latin arts, get mentoring and homework help, and train in civic engagement and youth organizing.
who_can_apply: Youth in grades 8 to 12. The page lists no residency rule.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted on the program page. The site has a Join Jovenes en Accion page.
how_to_apply: Use the APPLY NOW link on the Jovenes en Accion page of the Hyde Square Task Force site.
